subject.title: Fix Telegram durable partial final handling

question: Should this PR remain blocked until redacted real Telegram or restart-replay proof is attached, or should maintainers explicitly accept mocked tests and CI for this transport-facing fix?
rationale: The code path is source-plausible, but scoped Telegram policy and the external-PR proof gate require real behavior proof unless a maintainer intentionally overrides that standard.

options.title: Require Real Telegram Proof
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until a redacted Telegram Desktop, bot-to-bot, runtime-log, or restart/replay artifact shows the partial-visible and no-send durable failure paths.

options.title: Accept Unit-Only Evidence
options.body: Maintainers can explicitly accept the remaining transport uncertainty and proceed based on source inspection, regression tests, and green CI.

options.title: Pause Behind Broader Delivery Work
options.body: If maintainers want the broader final-delivery semantics work to own this edge, keep this PR paused until that merge path is clear.

recommendation.title: Require Real Telegram Proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR blocked until a redacted Telegram Desktop, bot-to-bot, runtime-log, or restart/replay artifact shows the partial-visible and no-send durable failure paths.
